purpose: Create a source-only V9 daily-down candidate that is readable yet retains the V9 glossy, cute two-reflection eye relationship.

reference.usage: The locked V9 image is the only generator reference. Previous V36 candidates remain comparison/rejection evidence, not prompt inputs.

output_contract.format: one unlabelled 200x200-equivalent V9 daily-down source face; no grid, text, border or alternate state
output_contract.pixel_intent: clean monochrome black ink on a plain white background; no grey, color, texture or shading
output_contract.allowed_change: only the enclosed white large glossy oval and small four-point companion sparkle inside each fixed V9 open black eye silhouette

daily_down_geometry.dominant_highlight: the same soft vertically elongated glossy oval language as V9, kept light and modestly lower than V9 rest without becoming a circular lower pupil-like disc
daily_down_geometry.companion_sparkle: the same small four-point V9-like sparkle, paired close to the oval toward the nose side without detaching
daily_down_geometry.relationship: both eyes preserve V9's balanced cute glossy relationship and settle into a gentle down glance; substantial black rim remains above and below the group

protected_identity: V9 outer black eye silhouette, placement and scale

forbidden: replace or edit the locked V9 source file
large lower circular white disc, dot-only eye, detached sparkle, cross-eye placement or extra charm
new outer eye silhouette, eye size or eye placement
new face, brow, mouth, cheek or charm art
full-face runtime frame, full-face animation loop or full-face state card
legacy art, custom LUT, code-drawn eye, candidate activation, provisioning or firmware flash
required_machine_gates_before_use: generated source SHA256 and lineage record
outer-eye silhouette/identity comparison against locked V9
native-200 cute-gloss and daily-down readability evidence after locked-V9-body reassembly
